scientific_integrity: The nonequivariant Betti numbers are explicitly attributed to Mostovoy (2026). Tuffley (2002, 2003) anticipates d=1 and aspects of d=2. The novel proof concerns the reflection-fixed configurations, induced characters, and finite quotient homology. One related Euler-characteristic preprint was inspected only at abstract level.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology and finite orthogonal group actions only. No integral torsion, ordinary homotopy type, homotopy quotient, or contractibility inference from rational acyclicity; d=1 not covered. An unindexed equivalent equivariant treatment remains possible.
title: Orthogonal homology characters and quotient dichotomy for finite subset spheres
